included_observation_classes.group_vectors: every message coordinate v_g[j], j < n, of every group vector (2 base rows each)
included_observation_classes.proximity_vector: every coordinate prox[j], j < n (2 base rows each)
included_observation_classes.terminals: every claim value (2 base rows each), including the H sum claim's public value 0
included_observation_classes.zero_sum: H only: the public constraint sum_j u[j] = 0 on the zero-sum mask row pair (2 base rows), proven by the zsum sumcheck
included_observation_classes.aliasing: one unknown per (row, column): rows opened by several claims are the same unknowns

excluded_observation_classes.pads: the Q pad coordinates v_g[n..n+Q) of every clear vector: linear in the Q fresh pad unknowns of each row, not in the message unknowns (FA2 section 14.6 argument; not modelled)
excluded_observation_classes.sampled_columns: the Q opened encoded columns (values, salts, paths): (f_row + Z_n g_pad) at coset points, hidden by the pads (Vandermonde) and the salted leaves (hash assumption); not modelled
excluded_observation_classes.cfs: the CFS mask commitment and the masked sumcheck round messages / claimed sums: nonlinear in the data; FA6
excluded_observation_classes.repeats: repeated proofs of the same witness (fresh challenges each): FA8; every capture is analysed alone
excluded_observation_classes.unopened_columns: the Merkle root over unopened columns: computational hiding assumption, outside a linear model

limits: Numerical rank of linear observations under the captured (fixed) public coefficients; not a simulator and not an upper bound on disclosure.
Pads, sampled columns, the CFS channel and repeated proofs are excluded (stated classes); FA6 and FA8 own those channels.
Every capture holds no witness: the recovered vectors are digested, never compared to truth here; truth comparison lives only in the in-process Rust harness (zk_ffn_mask_diagnostic).
Coverage ffn-v3-function-1 only (legacy profile); repaired-profile (ffn-v3-mr1) and function-2 captures need the handoff schema and are not analysed.
No private-block, deployment or throughput acceptance follows from this analysis.
